contradiction_conditions.description: verification_match_rate < 0.80 with concrete title/year mismatches indicating the METADATA_VERIFIED tier is not warranted for failing entries.

invalid_test_conditions.description: Crossref entirely unreachable, persistent HTTP 429/403 policy block, or script error preventing any valid query => TEST_INVALID_OR_ABORTED; results are NOT fabricated or substituted.

uncertainty_output: Finite census N=117 (no sampling error). Exact counts and rates reported. After applying the 5 in-tier crossref_year corrections to the registry, re-running the identical preregistered procedure yields title_match 117/117, year_match 117/117, full_match 117/117, retraction_signals 0. The only remaining flag is intra_registry_duplicate_dois=1 (DOI 10.1016/s0070-2153(07)81015-5 under GAP002-01 and GAP002-08), which is a documented intentional cross-gap citation (the same paper cited for two distinct gaps), not an external-evidence failure; the DOI still resolves and matches Crossref externally. Title comparison is exact normalized equality; a sensitivity check under loose-containment matching leaves title_match at 117/117.
adjudication_basis: The preregistered external-evidence success criteria are MET on the core external claim: verification_match_rate=1.0 (>=0.95), retraction_signals=0 (<=0), all 117 DOIs resolved, all 117 titles matched, all 117 years matched. The single preregistered sub-condition not met is intra_registry_duplicate_dois_max:0 (observed=1): the DOI 10.1016/s0070-2153(07)81015-5 is listed under two source_ids (GAP002-01, GAP002-08). Review established this is an INTERNAL registry cross-gap redundancy — the same paper is cited to support two distinct gaps — already flagged in-registry as is_duplicate_doi:true on GAP002-08, NOT an external-evidence failure (that DOI resolves and matches Crossref externally). It therefore does not flip the adjudication to PARTIAL/CONTRADICTED (those classes are defined by rate<0.95 / rate<0.80, neither of which applies; rate=1.0). The 5 year mismatches found in RUN-1 were corrected in-tier (crossref_year backfilled/corrected for GAP001-06, GAP002-02, GAP005-01, GAP008-06, GAP008-08) before this re-run; the re-run confirms 117/117 year match. Outcome: SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE on the external-evidence claim, with one documented minor caveat (the intentional duplicate DOI, retained and deferred to the task-104 data owner).
